summary: Polish the backend favicon maintenance page after Production validated V2.47.134 runtime behavior. The live task panel now uses stable fixed fields for progress, percent, completed, success, failed and current item so text no longer jumps each step; top metrics use clearer hierarchy; desktop pagination is reduced to 25 rows; long failure diagnostics are replaced by concise Chinese summaries with expandable technical details; filters and actions are consolidated into one mature toolbar. Rebuild behavior, cache semantics, provider/privacy/SSRF rules, SVG validation, schema and updater mechanism are unchanged. Production remains OWNER manual.
